description: Build the complete UI layer: AlertOverlay, Home screen, Settings, and MyPoints. Depends on FEAT-002 (services must exist). These components consume the state and handlers wired in App.tsx.
steps: Step 1 — Create `src/ui/AlertOverlay.tsx` and `src/ui/AlertOverlay.css`. Props: `alert: AlertEvent | null`, `onDismiss: () => void`. Behavior: when alert is null, renders nothing. When alert.visual === 'amarelo': render a fixed top banner (yellow background, high-contrast dark text, z-index 1000) showing alert.mensagem; auto-dismiss after 5000 ms via useEffect with cleanup; CSS class `alert-banner-yellow`. When alert.visual === 'vermelho_piscando': render a full-screen overlay (red background, z-index 1000) with alert.mensagem in large white bold text centered; animate background-color between #cc0000 and #ff4444 at 2 Hz (500 ms cycle) using CSS @keyframes `flash-red`; auto-dismiss after 8000 ms OR when onDismiss is called; CSS class `alert-overlay-red`. Both overlays: accessible (role='alert', aria-live='assertive'). On new alert prop arriving, reset the dismiss timer. Do NOT render when app is in background — this is inherent since the component only renders when React is active.

Step 2 — Create `src/ui/Home.tsx` and `src/ui/Home.css`. Props: `isMonitoring: boolean`, `currentPos: {lat:number,lon:number,velKmh:number,heading:number|null} | null`, `nextEvent: AlertEvent | null`, `visualAlert: AlertEvent | null`, `onStart: () => void`, `onStop: () => void`, `onMarkRadar: () => void`, `onDismissAlert: () => void`. Layout (dark theme, #1a1a1a background, white/yellow text): (a) Top row: GPS status dot (green=ok, grey=no signal) + 'GPS ok' or 'Sem sinal' label, right side shows 'MOCK' badge when VITE_MOCK_GPS=true. (b) Center: speed in large font (min 64px), 'km/h' label below. (c) Next point info block: 'Próximo: {tipo}' on first line, 'Limite {n} km/h · ~{dist}m' on second line, where dist is rounded to nearest 50 m (Math.round(distM / 50) * 50); show '—' when no nextEvent. (d) Primary button: large rounded button, label 'INICIAR MONITORAMENTO' / 'PARAR MONITORAMENTO', green/red background. (e) Secondary button: 'MARCAR RADAR AQUI', grey background. (f) Bottom link: '⚙ Configurações' that calls onSettingsOpen (add this prop too). Include `<AlertOverlay alert={visualAlert} onDismiss={onDismissAlert} />`. All text minimum 16px, buttons minimum 56px height. High contrast: WCAG AA minimum for dark background.

Step 3 — Create the 'Marcar Radar' inline modal. When 'MARCAR RADAR AQUI' is tapped, show an inline bottom sheet (fixed, bottom 0, full width) with: a row of type selector buttons (RF, RM, SR, SC, PRv, LOM — one tap to select, highlighted selected), an optional number input for 'Limite km/h (opcional)', a 'SALVAR' button, and an 'X' cancel button. On save: create a new `UserPoint` with `{ id: crypto.randomUUID(), lat: currentPos.lat, lon: currentPos.lon, tipo: selectedTipo, limite: parsedLimite, criadoEm: Date.now() }` — if currentPos is null, show a brief error 'Aguarde o GPS'. Call saveUserPoints([...userPoints, newPoint]) via storage.ts, update in-memory userPoints, and call dispatcher.recreate() with the merged dataset. Close the sheet. The limit input accepts 0 as 'not informed'. Do NOT log or display coordinates anywhere in this flow.

Step 4 — Create `src/ui/Settings.tsx` and `src/ui/Settings.css`. Props: `settings: AppSettings`, `onSave: (s: AppSettings) => void`, `onClose: () => void`. Sections: (a) 'Tipos de ponto' — one toggle per type: RF, RM, SR, SC, PRv, LOM, PED. Each toggle is a large tappable row (min 48px). Default state reflects settings.tiposAtivos (PED off by default, others on). (b) 'Avisos' — toggle 'Voz em português' (settings.vozAtiva), slider 'Volume do alarme' 0–1 (settings.volume), toggle 'Avisar quando estiver acima do limite' (settings.avisarAcimaLimite). (c) 'Tela' — toggle 'Manter tela ligada' (settings.manterTela). (d) 'Bateria' — informational text: 'Para garantir o funcionamento em segundo plano, desative a otimização de bateria para este app nas configurações do Android.' (e) Save button calls onSave with new settings object and onClose. All changes are local until Save. Use dark theme matching Home.tsx.

Step 5 — Create `src/ui/MyPoints.tsx` and `src/ui/MyPoints.css`. Props: `userPoints: UserPoint[]`, `onUpdate: (pts: UserPoint[]) => void`, `onClose: () => void`, `onReplaceBase: (data: DatasetJson) => void`. Sections: (a) List of user points, each row showing tipo + limite + formatted date, with Edit and Delete buttons. Edit opens an inline form (same type selector + limit input). Delete removes from list and calls saveUserPoints + onUpdate. (b) 'Exportar pontos' button: serializes userPoints to JSON, creates a Blob, triggers download via `<a>` element with `download='meus-radares.json'`. (c) 'Importar pontos' button: triggers `<input type='file' accept='.json'>`, reads the file as text, calls validateImport(JSON.parse(text), 5_000_000) from dataset.ts — on success replaces userPoints, calls saveUserPoints + onUpdate + dispatcher.recreate(); on failure shows an inline error message (not a stack trace). (d) 'Substituir base de radares' button: same file picker flow but on success calls onReplaceBase(data.data) — which in App.tsx stores the new base and recreates the engine. On any error: show 'Arquivo inválido. Verifique o formato e tente novamente.' Never crash the app. Use dark theme.

Step 6 — Create `src/ui/Disclaimer.tsx`. Props: `onAccept: () => void`. Full-screen modal overlay with text: 'A base de radares pode estar desatualizada ou incompleta. Respeite sempre os limites de velocidade e a sinalização de trânsito.' and a single 'Entendi' button that calls onAccept. Dark background, white text, high contrast.

Step 7 — Update `src/App.tsx` to fully integrate all UI components. Use React state for: `screen: 'home' | 'settings' | 'mypoints'`. Render: if !disclaimerSeen → `<Disclaimer onAccept={...} />`; else if screen==='home' → `<Home ...all props... onSettingsOpen={() => setScreen('settings')} />`; else if screen==='settings' → `<Settings settings={settings} onSave={(s) => { saveSettings(s); setSettings(s); dispatcher.recreate(mergedDataset, s); setScreen('home'); }} onClose={() => setScreen('home')} />`; else `<MyPoints ... onClose={() => setScreen('home')} />`. Add an error boundary class component that catches render errors and shows 'Ocorreu um erro. Reinicie o aplicativo.' without any stack trace. Wrap root in the error boundary.
Step 8 — Run `npm run build`. Fix any TypeScript/CSS errors before marking complete.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors
AlertOverlay renders yellow banner for visual='amarelo' and red flashing for visual='vermelho_piscando' — confirmed by visual inspection in browser (run `npm run dev` briefly)
Home.tsx displays speed, next-point info, Start/Stop button, Marcar Radar button, and Settings link
Settings.tsx has toggles for all 7 point types, voice toggle, volume slider, keep-awake toggle, and battery guidance text
MyPoints.tsx has export (downloads JSON file), import (validates before accepting, shows error on invalid), and base-replace flows
Disclaimer.tsx shows on first launch (before disclaimerSeen is set) and calls markDisclaimerSeen on accept
No stack trace is shown to the user anywhere — all errors produce short messages
Error boundary wraps the whole app
findings: All UI components created under src/ui/. App.tsx fully rewritten with error boundary wrapping the entire app. saveUserPoints is called directly in Home.tsx (mark radar) and MyPoints.tsx (edit/delete/import) rather than in App.tsx to keep data flow simple — App receives the updated array via callbacks and calls mergeDataset + dispatcher.recreate. The unused saveUserPoints import was removed from App.tsx (tsc error TS6133). npm run build exits 0 (44 modules, 329 kB main bundle). npx cap sync exits 0 with all 4 Capacitor plugins found. No network dependencies added. Coordinates are never stored or logged. VITE_MOCK_GPS badge is shown via import.meta.env.VITE_MOCK_GPS.
